RESEARCH PROPOSAL

Title: Escalation Dynamics in Public Demonstrations: A Multi-Case Analysis
PI: [Name], Department of Sociology
Status: IRB Approved (Protocol #2024-0847)

Abstract: This study examines the behavioral and situational factors that contribute to the escalation of peaceful protests into violent confrontations. Using a comparative case study methodology across 30 incidents from 2018-2024, we identify recurring patterns in crowd behavior, police response, and environmental triggers.

Section 3 (In Progress): Taxonomy of Escalation Factors
- 3.1 Precipitating incidents
- 3.2 Crowd behavioral shifts
- 3.3 Communication patterns
- 3.4 Environmental and logistical factors
